sections.title: 45-51 SALAH KEEPS ONE AWAY FROM THE SHAMEFUL DEEDS AND DO NOT ARGUE WITH THE PEOPLE OF THE BOOK EXCEPT IN GOOD TASTE

arabic_lines: اُتۡلُ مَاۤ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ ؕ اِنَّ الصَّلٰوةَ تَنۡهٰى عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِؕ وَلَذِكۡرُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُ
وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُوۡنَ

translation.text: (O Prophet), recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah's remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.

commentary.text: The address apparently is directed to the Prophet (PBUH) but, in fact, it is meant for all believers. We are being given two direct commands: (i) recite the Quran (ii) establish Salah. These are practical tools which enable a believer the fortitude to withstand even the most trying of circumstances.

The first part of the Surah outlines the difficulties a believer faces after declaring Iman/faith. The solution provided by Allah SWT to overcome troubles is not to cling onto a flimsy spider’s web (false gods in whatever form) rather hold on firmly, and seek comfort with Allah SWT through the Quran and Salah.
Recite the Quran means to recite, understand, obey and then convey.

Establish prayer to build a connection, and direct channel of communication and love with Allah SWT. The benefits of salah include that it prevents us from committing sin (indecency and evil) because during salah we develop Allah consciousness. Additionally, with every salah our sins are removed from us like leaves falling off a dry branch.

Hadith: "A man came to the Prophet (PBUH) and said, `So-and-so prays at night, but when morning comes, he steals. The Prophet (PBUH) said: What you are saying (i.e., the Salah) will stop him from doing that. Thus, in sha Allah through prayer his conscience is being awakened several times a day.

Note:  Allah SWT remembrance or the zikr of Allah SWT, includes but is not limited to, our daily morning and evening zikr (duas), sunnah duas (i.e dua for going into a bathroom, putting on clothes etc.), duas we read after namaz, for example, AH, Subhan Allah, Allah hu Akbar. Thus, we remember Allah SWT throughout our day and don’t compartmentalize religion to specific events or times during the day.
The zikr of Allah SWT keeps us enveloped in His Rehmat (mercy).

translation.text: Do not argue with the People of the Book unless gracefully, except with those of them who act wrongfully. And say, “We believe in what has been revealed to us and what was revealed to you. Our God and your God is ˹only˺ One. And to Him we ˹fully˺ submit.”

commentary.text: Here the etiquettes of discussing religion are mentioned: (i) invite people with wisdom i.e. be knowledgeable and have convincing and engaging reasoning. Appeal to the heart and do not fight only with the objective of defeating your opponent. (ii) But when the discussion takes an aggressive turn then STOP!
Exception: Islam teaches us to be polite, gentle and reasonable however it does not teach us to be unduly humble and meek so that we are taken for granted.
Guidelines and etiquettes we must follow during any religious debate or discussion:
Manners (best)
Stop when discussion becomes heated or hostile.
Revert to commonalities, that is, the discussion should start and end from the points of agreement and not from the points of difference i.e. we all believe in One God.

At this place the people of the book are especially identified for the reason given right after this. That is, if they were to ponder, there is a great deal common in the two faiths, which should help them accept Islam. Hence it is said; And say: (We believe in what is sent down to us and sent down to you - 29:46).

Muslims, at the time of an argument should tell the people of the book that we have faith in the revelations sent to us through our Prophet and also on those revelations which were sent to you through your prophets. Hence, there is no reason for any hostility between us. 

Does this Ayat endorse the authenticity of Torah and Injil in their present form?

Muslims have faith only on that part of Torah and Injil that were revealed on Sayyidna Musa (علیہ السلام) and Sayyidna Isa (علیہ السلام) respectively. The altered part of the books is excluded from that.

translation.text: Does it not suffice for them (as a Sign) that We revealed to you the Book that is recited to them? Surely there is mercy and good counsel in it for those who believe.

commentary.text: The Quran is a miracle (if only we understood its majesty). Allah SWT describes the Quran as a blessing and reminder but only for those who believe.
Lesson: Quran are the words of our Maker. We are doing ourselves a huge disservice if we don’t give the Quran is due. Recite, understand and obey then convey.

sections.title: 52 – 63 HOW MANY CREATURES ARE THERE WHO DO NOT CARRY THEIR PROVISIONS WITH THEM? ALLAH PROVIDES THEM AS HE PROVIDES YOU

arabic_lines: يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ

translation.text: O My servants who believe! Certainly, spacious is My earth. Therefore worship Me.

commentary.text: Advice to Migrate and the promise of Provision and a good Reward.
Here Allah SWT addresses his servants is such a loving and gentle manner because He knows that it is not easy to leave one’s home and migrate.

Context: When things became exceedingly difficult for the believers in Makkah they migrated to Ethiopia, where they were able to practice their religion freely. Later, the Messenger of Allah and his remaining companions migrated to Al-Madinah, formerly known as Yathrib.

Lesson: This is our one and only chance so live life in a manner that does not compromise on religion.  Live life to the fullest in obedience to Allah SWT. If someone or some place is preventing you from obeying/practicing Islam then leave. Have the courage to migrate.

arabic_lines: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

translation.text: Everyone shall taste death. Then unto Us you shall be returned.

commentary.text: Death is inevitable and there is no escape from it, soon we will return to Allah SWT and whoever was obedient to Him will have the best reward.

arabic_lines: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارخَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ

translation.text: ˹As for˺ those who believe and do good, We will certainly house them in ˹elevated˺ mansions in Paradise, under which rivers flow, to stay there forever. How excellent is the reward for those who work ˹righteousness!˺—

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + good deeds = Salvation

translation.text: Those who are patient, and put their trust in their Lord.

commentary.text: Formula for success: (i) steadfastness/tolerance/persistence in every situation i.e. in good times and in bad times. (ii) And complete reliance and trust in Allah SWT. If turn to anyone or anything besides Allah SWT, for example, money, power, other people, our intelligence, etc., then it is like turning to a spider’s web (flimsy, weak, and pathetic) for support.

arabic_lines: وَكَأَيِّن مِن دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ

translation.text: And so many a moving creature carries not its own provision! Allah provides for it and for you.

commentary.text: Allah SWT sends provision to every creature in the appropriate manner, including, ants in the depths of the earth, birds in the air and the fish in the sea. Allah SWT in His wisdom gives us the example to humming birds who migrate thousands of miles with no stored provisions.

Lesson: Depend only on Allah SWT for all forms of provision (job, money, spouse, children etc). Depending on any others (boss, power, fame, money etc.) as your sustainer is like holding on to a spider’s web (insubstantial and fragile). Include no one in your worship/reliance of Allah SWT. Thus, do not commit shirk.

sections.title: 64-69 THE LIFE OF THIS WORLD IS NOTHING BUT A PASTIME, THE REAL LIFE IS THE LIFE HEREAFTER AND THOSE WHO STRIVE IN OUR CAUSE, WE DO GUIDE THEM TO OUR WAY

translation.text: The present life is nothing but sport and amusement. The true life is in the Abode of the Hereafter; if only they knew.

commentary.text: Allah SWT tells us how insignificant and transient this world is, and how it will soon end. Allah SWT describes this life as nothing but a distraction or meaningless play with the real life being in the Hereafter.  Why then are we not taking heed!

The reality of this world is no more than children engaging in play or pastime and then returning home. The one who become a king here, has not become a king in reality but is only playing the king. A time comes when his play ends, and he leaves the royal throne as empty-handed as he was when he had entered the world.

If only people realized that the reality of this life is a time for preparation and the real life which is everlasting, is the life of the Hereafter. With this realization we would not waste precious time in merry making rather would utilize each moment to attain success in the eternal life of the Hereafter.
Lesson: Time is of the essence – our eternal life awaits.

arabic_lines: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translation.text: As for those who strive in Our cause, We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.

commentary.text: The word “mujahadah” is explained below and in Ayat 6.

Here we are being reassured that Allah SWT does not leave those who sincerely strive (do jihad) for His cause. He helps and guides them and opens up paths towards Himself. He shows them the light at every turning point to discriminate between the right way and the wrong ways of life. Thus, Allah SWT aids/assists and shows/steers believers according to their sincerity and intensity of desire for goodness. This is Allah's promise and Allah never ever goes back on his promise. So, hold on firmly to Allah SWT and not to others who are like a spider’s web (feeble and imperfect.)

Lesson: Life is difficult but for a believer much more so as one is always struggling against satan. The good news is that we are not alone. Allah SWT will guide us to success. We have to keep doing jihad/striving and Allah SWT will take care of us.
This struggle is real.

The word “mujahadah” means to strive, struggle and exert one’s utmost against an opponent. The struggle of a believer similar as he has to fight against Satan, who constantly frightens him regarding possible losses that one has to incur for the sake of good and allures him with the benefits and pleasures of the evil.
A believer also has to fight against his own desires/fancies/whims.
A believer also has to fight against, trends, morality, customs, way of life and social and economic principles that may be in conflict with his faith.
And the list goes on…..
The struggle is not of a day or two, but of an entire lifetime, of every moment of the day and night. And it is not a struggle in one field only but on every front of life.
This struggle is real.
Problem stated: (Ayat 2) Iman does not come with mere lip service.
Solution: In times/situations of difficulty turn only to Allah SWT and not others who are like a spider’s web (weak/frail/ineffectual).
Remember life is temporary thus hardship is temporary.

Allah SWT is with those who do jihad for His cause. (SUCCESS)

It is believed that this Surah was revealed to strengthen and encourage the new Muslims who were, at the time, suffering severe abuse and oppression.  Also, a clear connection is established between all previous Prophets and their messages and the message of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) so as to encourage him during this difficult time.
The Issues:
With one's declaration of iman comes tests/difficulties/obstacles etc. (Ayat 2)
Advice/guidance for young people and new converts regarding how to deal with pressure from friends and family who encourage you to abandon religion. (Ayat 8)
The issue of losing one’s strength/fortitude/hope in the face of difficulties. (Ayat 9)
Solutions/Guidance from Allah SWT:
Build your connection with Allah (so as to successfully withstand/navigate any test/trial)
Recite/understand/convey the Quran. (Ayat 45)
Establish salah as it instills Allah consciousness (tawkul and sabar) and stops us from shamelessness and sin. (Ayat 45)
Remembrance/zikr of Allah SWT. A believer's lips should always be moist with the remembrance of Allah SWT -- via duas, zikr esp. AM & PM, and tasbeeh. (Ayat 45)
Etiquette of giving dawa or discussing religion.
Discuss religion in the best possible manner with the best possible manners. Don’t get aggressive. Speak from a place of knowledge. Speak kindly and gently. (Ayat 46)
Speak kindly and gently however if the other party gets overly aggressive then either (i) leave or retaliate (briefly) to show you are not overtly meek or passive. (Ayat 46)
Begin dialogues from a place of commonalties. One Allah etc. (Ayat 46)
Hijrat/Migrate: If you cannot practice your religion with some degree of freedom and comfort then leave till you reach a place where you can. (Ayat 25)

Provision/sustenance is provided only by Allah SWT. Ask only your Lord and rely only on your Raab for ALL khair and provision (money, family, abode, off spring etc). Example of living creatures including birds. ( Ayat 17 & 60)
This world is but a playground, a temporary distraction. Prepare for death. Prepare for the real life that is every lasting. We will taste death very soon. (Ayat 64)
Allah SWT’s promise is a surety for those who believe but one has to do jihad and strive with upmost determination and conviction. Heaven will not be attained just via lip service. (Ayat 69)

Life is hard but esp. for a believer. Test/difficulties continue to be an integral part of our existence. Take Allah SWT as your wali (guardian) because taking the support of money, friends, power etc. is like relying on a spider's web for support. (Ayat 41)

Inevitably, in the life of a believer a situation occurs when he/she is left with no alternative but to place all trust in Allah SWT, regardless of external support from the material world. In these conditions, those who are too calculating about the future and seek guarantees regarding the assurance of provisions such people always loose out. So no matter how trying the circumstance revert to the Quran for guidance and rely on Allah SWT ONLY!
BRIEF SYNOPSIS OF SECTIONS:
Belief dictates behavior. Tests and trials are part of faith – 1-13

The intense persecution made it dangerous to be followers of the Messenger (PBUH).  Immediately, believers are informed that their faith will be tested just as the people/nations who came before them were tested, This is how God makes clear or separates the liars from those who are truthful.  It is not enough to claim belief; belief imposes certain duties/responsibilities/rights. However, those who believe and behave righteously do so for their own benefit as Allah SWT is free of needs and wants.

God demands that a believer be good to his or her parents. However, we are instructed not obey them if they try to make you worship something other than God. There are people who waver in their belief whenever they are faced with difficulties; but then when they are in a position of ease, they make boastful claims about their belief.  Their faith is easily shaken.  Therefore, we should all look within and be firm.
Prophet Nuh and Ibrahim – 14 -27

In these Ayats the central theme is the constant confrontation between belief and disbelief – truth and falsehood, symbolized by the antagonism between Ibrahim and Nimrod; between Musa and Pharaoh, and the struggle between Nuh and his people. So, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is encouraged to face the hostility from the likes of Abu Jahl and Abu Lahab in Makkah.

Nuh (PBUH) spread Allah SWT's message amongst his people for nearly one thousand years yet his nation refused to believe at which point a flood overtook them.  Ibrahhim (PBUH) tried to warn his people against idol worship and told them to seek their provision from God.  He warned them with stories from their own past and with logical arguments about the power and mercy of God.   Their only response was to call for Ibrahim’s death.

Prophet Ibrahim safely walked out of the fire that was meant to kill him and called on his nation to reject idol worship, warning them that fire will be their eternal abode.  Lut (PBUH) witnessed this event and then reaffirmed his faith.  Prophet Ibrahim was the father of a long line of prophets starting with his son Isaac and grandson Jacob. Prophet Ibrahim’s reward began in this world and will continue in the Hereafter as he was and will be among the righteous.
The story of Prophet Lut – 28 – 35

Lut (PBUH) tried to counsel his people asking them to stop their immoral practices (homosexuality), their acts of highway robbery, and corruption.  But their response to good counsel was to tell Lut (PBUH) to bring on the punishment. Lut (PBUH) prayed to God for help. Prophet Lut and his household were saved from God’s torment.  However his wife would not be amongst those saved.The ruins of the town were left so that people who think would understand.
Prophet Shuaib & Musa – 36 – 40

Prophet Shuaib was denied by his people; the people of Midian.  God therefore sent an earthquake that overtook them in the night.  The people of Ad and Thamud were also destroyed.  Satan made their evil deeds seem fair/good and thus diverted them from the right path. Prophet Musa went to Pharaoh with clear undeniable signs but they too were arrogant and refused to believe.  They could not however outrun God’s punishment.
God is All-Knowing – 41 - 59
The metaphor of the spider’s web is used to convey the weakness and frailty of worldly support, in contrast to the enduring nature of Allah SWT's help -- although there is no comparison.
(29: 41) “An example of people who take supporters beside Allah is like a spider making a web. Indeed, the weakest of homes is a spider’s web”

Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and then by default all us believers are told to recite from the Quran and to establish the prayer because remembrance of God keeps people away from shameful deeds and wrongdoing.  Only argue with the People of the Book in a good way, explain that their God and your God is One and the same. Many of those given the scriptures believe in the Quran; only the defiant refuse.

God knows everything in the heavens and the earth and those who disbelieve will be the losers.  he time for the punishment is already set. If that was not the case punishment would already have befallen them but Allah in his infinite mercy always gives his servants multiple chances to turn back/repent. But for some Hell has already encircled them. God’s earth is spacious, so if need be migrate to where you can worship Him. Everyone dies and everyone will return to God.  Those who believed and did good deeds will live in magnificent dwellings in gardens under which rivers flow.
The signs that make things clear – 60-69

If you ask the disbelievers who created the heavens and the earth, or who sends down the rain, they would answer, God.  Why then do they continue to deny the signs? Why do they not use their common sense? This life is nothing but a diversion, an amusement for a short time. It is the Hereafter that is the real life. When a person gets into trouble, they call upon God but when he saves them, they forget that they should be grateful and begin to thank others for their rescue. Let them deny God’s favors and enjoy themselves for they will come to realize. There is none more wicked than a person who lies about God or denies the truth after it has been made clear. Hell will be their abode.

front_matter.text: The Surah takes its name Ar-Rum from the second Ayat in which the words “ghulibat-ir-Rum” have occurred.

items.text: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ
(30:2) The Romans have been defeated.

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: The period of revelation is determined by the historical event of the Roman defeat. This is a Makki Surah revealed about 5 years after Prophethood, the same year in which the first Hijrah to Ebyssinia took place. The Surah has 60 Ayats in 6 Rukus.

front_matter.label: Subject and Topics
front_matter.text:
The discourse begins with the Roman defeat. Allah SWT's prediction is that within a few years the tables will be turned and the vanquished will again become victorious.

This introductory theme contains the great truth that man is accustomed to seeing only what is apparent and superficial. The Surah reminds us that Allah SWT is in control of everything. In this connection, the signs/Ayat’s/evidences/miracles of the universe are presented as evidence to prove doctrine of Tawhid.

From Ayat 28 onwards, the discourse turns to the affirmation of Tawhid and the refutation of shirk, and it is stressed that the natural way of life for man (fitra) is to serve One God exclusively. Shirk is opposed to the nature of man, therefore, whenever man has adopted this deviation, chaos (fasaad) has resulted.

Surahs Ankabut + Luqman has similar themes. Then Surah Rum and Surah Sajdah have similar themes. All four surahs make a sub-group.

sections.title: 1-10 ROMANS (CHRISTIANS) DEFEAT AT THE HANDS OF PERSIAN (PAGANS) WAS TAKEN AS A SIGN OF THE MUSLIMS DEFEAT AT THE HANDS OF ARAB'S UNBELIEVERS, SO ALLAH SWT GAVE GOOD TIDINGS FOR ROMAN'S VICTORY AS WELL AS MUSLIMS VICTORY IN A FEW YEARS

arabic_lines: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ

translation.text: The Romans have been defeated.

commentary.text: These Ayat’s were revealed after the victory of the king of Persia, (Greater Syria). Heraclius, the emperor of the Romans, was forced to flee to Constantinople where he was besieged for a lengthy period. Then Heraclius regained the upper hand.

The Muslims wanted the Romans (Christians) to prevail over the Persians because they were people who followed a Book. The Quraysh, on the other hand, wanted the Persians to prevail, because like the Quraysh the Persians did not follow a Book nor did they believe in resurrection.

arabic_lines: فِىۡۤ اَدۡنَى الۡاَرۡضِ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡۢ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُوۡنَۙ

translation.text: in the neighbouring land; but after their defeat they shall gain victory in a few years.
within three to nine years. The ˹whole˺ matter rests with Allah before and after ˹victory˺. And on that day the believers will rejoice

commentary.text: Predicting the Victory of the Romans
Within nine years Allah SWT's predications were realized, that is, the Romans were victorious and at the same time Muslims achieved a decisive victory at the Battle of Badr against the Mushrikeen.

Lesson: Circumstances change so don’t wallow in sorrows and don’t exalt victories, instead, look towards the future and realize that Allah SWT has a plan and a time. Understand that change can be gradual, just look at how the day vicissitudes into the night very gradually and steadily that we don’t even perceive it.

translation.text: People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.

commentary.text: Disbelievers only see the outward/apparent aspect of things and engage in a shallow analysis of events. They do not bother to take a deep dive into why we are on this universe and what is our purpose? Therefore, because the Afterlife is of the unseen realities and therefore not obvious, they are completely heedless or oblivious towards it.

Despite the plethora of signs and evidences which clearly point to the oneness of Allah SWT if people remain in heedless it is only due to their own short-sightedness and their wish to follow their own desires.

translation.text: Have they not reflected upon their own being? Allah only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet most people are truly in denial of the meeting with their Lord!

commentary.text: **Some feel that the events relating to the battles mentioned above were all leading up to the revelation of these Ayat’s. The purpose was to reveal these gems that we now need to focus on (pls see below.)

Allah SWT created everything with a purpose and with a deadline but most do not reflect and are in complete denial. There is a great wisdom in the creation of this universe, which is, that people should recognize their Creator through all His creations and thus seek what He likes and stay clear of what He dislikes. Man’s goal should be to please Allah SWT as much as possible and avoid that which displeases Him. 

However, disbelievers are engrossed in the temporary mundane glitter and transitory pleasures of this world and in denial of its ultimate end when each one of us shall be full recompensed for what we did on this earth.

translation.text: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might; they cultivated the land and developed it more than these ˹Meccans˺ ever have. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. Allah would have never wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves.

commentary.text: Allah SWT asks the Makkans, that during their trips, have they not witnessed the fate of the earlier people/nations who for their advanced skills and way of living, they were regarded as civilized nations. But they got so captivated in material life with it’s transitory luxuries and comforts that they forgot Allah SWT and the Hereafter.

Then, Allah SWT sent Prophets and Books to remind them of their duties, but still, they did not pay any heed. Ultimately, they were overtaken by Allah's wrath and the ruins of their desolate cities still stand as a witness to their destruction.
At the end of the Ayat, it is suggested as to whether they were subjected to any oppression from Allah SWT or did they seal their own fate by accumulating causes of the divine punishment.

translation.text: Then most evil was the end of the evildoers for denying and mocking the signs of Allah.

commentary.text: Allah SWT promises a most vile and nasty end to those who deny and those who mock/make fun of the signs of Allah SWT.
Lesson: Do not ever make fun of or mock of Allah SWT or deen because you are asking for an evil end.

sections.title: 11-19 IT IS ALLAH SWT WHO ORIGINATES THE CREATION AND THEN REPEATS IT AND TO HIM EVERYONE WILL BE BROUGHT FOR THE FINAL JUDGEMENT

translation.text: Allah creates in the first instance and will later repeat it. Thereafter it is to Him that you shall be sent back.

commentary.text: Signs of Tawhid

Allah SWT created us in the first place and thus resurrection will be easy for Allah SWT. In life the first time we attempt anything it is difficult, however, the second time things come much easier, for example, cooking or writing a report, etc.

arabic_lines: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَهُمْ فِي رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ

translation.text: Then as for those who believed and did righteous good deeds, such shall be honored and made to enjoy a luxurious life in a Garden of Delight.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS BY ALLAH SWT
Iman + good deeds = Paradise

arabic_lines: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ

translation.text: So glorify Allah SWT, when you enter the evening, and when you enter the morning.

commentary.text: Declare the perfection of Allah SWT particularly at the time of fajr and maghrib. We are told to declare the perfection of Allah. Make the right choice now and consciously declare the perfection of Allah SWT before it is too late.
FYI -- Subhan Allah is not a statement of fact but rather a call to action. AH is statement of fact.

translation.text: all praise is for Him in the heavens and the earth—as well as in the afternoon, and at noon.

commentary.text: The Command to pray Five Times Daily
Pray at the proper times and do tasbeeh/zirk especially during the morning and evening hours.

Lesson: Glorify Allah SWT when we receive something and glorify Allah SWT when we lose something. Nothing is permanent except Allah SWT so rely on Allah SWT alone because sooner that we ever anticipate we will all be standing in front to Him.

sections.title: 20-27 CREATION OF MAN, HIS MATE IN MARRIAGE, HEAVENS, EARTH, LANGUAGE, COLORS, SLEEP, QUEST FOR WORK, LIGHTENING, RAIN AND GROWTH OF VEGETATION ARE ALL FROM THE SIGNS OF ALLAH SWT

arabic_lines: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا لِّتَسۡكُنُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحۡمَةً

translation.text: And of His Signs is that He has created mates for you from your own kind that you may find peace in them and He has set between you love and mercy. Surely there are Signs in this for those who reflect.

commentary.text: The purpose for the institution of marriage is described here, that is, to find as well as to provide, peace, tranquility, pleasure and calmness with your spouse and the family. It is said that at the time of the nikkah Allah SWT's gift to the newlywed is the gift of instilling love and mercy between the couple. It is up to the couple then to keep this love and mercy alive. Allah SWT's help is with those who strive and work hard so do your best in marriage as well and ask Allah SWT for barakah (blessings) in their marriage.
Three key ingredients for a successful marriage mentioned: (i) Peace (ii) Love (iii) Mercy.
More often than not the wife creates the family dynamic/mood therefore, she should be mindful of this fact and create an environment that Allah SWT would be pleased with.
Among the Signs of Allah SWT (وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ)

The Ayats/signs/evidences/miracles of Allah SWT include but are not limited to, that He created humans out of dust, created their spouses, the ability to sleep /rest at night and then work during the day, the sky that stands without any support or pillars and the earth with all it's vegetation that it harvests which dies and then with rain a barren land is brought back to life.

Note: Sign or a landmark by which something or someone is recognized. Thus, Ayats/signs/miracles in the universe point to the existence of the Creator, for example, the origin of mankind and then existence on earth is a miracle/sign.
Look beyond the apparent

Victory and loss where it be in battles or in life are temporary so don’t indulge in fleeting pleasures or disappointments to a point of distraction. Rather focus on the much grander end game that is the Hereafter and understand you purpose in life.
Quran turns everything into a spiritual experience because when we fully appreciate the Ayat/signs/miracles of Allah

SWT it changes our perspective. All around us we witness miracles come to life; whether it be the leaves changing colors, the clouds moving effortlessly, or the beauty in individual faces. Thus, adopting this holistic approach towards deen ensures that everything begins and ends with Allah SWT. In this Surah Allah encourages us look inward.

Lesson: Although the fall and then victory of the Romans is mentioned as a miraculous sign or prediction by Allah SWT, nevertheless it is only one of many signs or Ayat’s of Allah SWT. We need to pay attention to the Ayat’s/signs of Allah SWT that are all around us so as to recognize our Raab’s majesty and supremacy – then submit humbly.

sections.title: 28-32 THE COMMAND TO ADHERE TO TAWHID AND ESTABLISH PRAYERS. WRONGDOERS ARE LED BY THEIR OWN APPETITES WITHOUT REAL KNOWLEDGE

arabic_lines: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا

translation.text: (O Prophet and his followers), turn your face singlemindedly to the true Faith and adhere to the true nature on which Allah has created human beings. The mold fashioned by Allah cannot be altered. That is the True, Straight Faith, although most people do not know.

commentary.text: Allah SWT commands us to recognize that our singular purpose in life is to worship Him exclusively.

Allah SWT has created us (humans) upon the fitrah of Islam meaning that instinctively or innately we are inclined towards tawhid and we know the difference between right and wrong, truth and falsehood etc. However, with the continuation of sins this ‘fitrah’ is suppressed often to a point of no return.
Hanifa: mostly synonymous with Prophet Ibrahim (PBUH), means the one who is sincere to Allah SWT and does not deviate. Worship is exclusively for Allah SWT.

Fitrah: means natural pre-disposition or state. People are born upon this programming of fitrah, for example, the human moral code of decency, morality, charity, mercy, love, patience etc. are all included in our fitra. Religion then confirms and perfects these qualities; thus, Islam just unlocks the doormat deen that is already in us. Hadith: Every child is born on fitra.

translation.text: ˹O believers!˺ Always turn to Him ˹in repentance˺, be mindful of Him, and establish prayers. And do not be of those who ascribe partners to God

commentary.text: Allah SWT commands us to (i) turn to Allah SWT in forgiveness (out of love and gratitude) and (ii) be fully attentive/mindful of your Raab, (iii) establish salah, and (iv) do not be of those who commit shirk.

Salah is our connection with our Raab. The angels hold back their pen when recording a sin so as to give us an opportunity to repent therefore after every salah we should ask for forgiveness and repent.
Hadith: No person who sins, does wudu, prays 2 rakat salah of forgiveness that his/her sins will not be lessened.
Lesson: Fill your day with istakfar. Repeatedly ask Allah SWT for leniency/mercy/pardon.

sections.title: 33-37 WHEN AFFLICTION BEFALLS PEOPLE THEY CALL UPON ALLAH SWT, BUT WHEN HE RELIEVES THEM, LO! THEY START COMMITTING SHIRK

translation.text: When people are touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He gives them a taste of His mercy, a group of them associates ˹others˺ with their Lord ˹in worship˺

commentary.text: How man sways between Tawhid and Shirk, and between Joy and Despair, according to His Circumstances
In times of adversity people call upon Allah SWT exclusively, and all religions, all divisions, all sects disappear. Even if you live in shirk; calamities help you turn towards Allah SWT for aid.
This is proof that we are born of fitrah.

translation.text: When We give people a taste of Our blessing, they rejoice, but when something bad happens to them– because of their own actions– they fall into utter despair.

commentary.text: Do not vacillate between elation and hopelessness depending upon your circumstances instead remain steadfast in your reliance on your Raab, seek repentance often and be grateful to Allah SWT.

Allah SWT says, “…but when something bad happens to them– because of their own actions– they fall into utter despair,” meaning often hardships arise due to our deeds or actions. So, when hit with any calamity we should always look within.

sections.title: 38 COMMANDMENTS TO GIVE THE RELATIVES THEIR DUE AND LIKEWISE TO THE POOR AND THE TRAVELLERS IN NEED
39 PROHIBITIONS OF RIBA AND OBLIGATION TO GIVE ZAKAT
40 GLORIFY ALLAH SWT – SUBHANALLAH SWT

arabic_lines: فَاٰتِ ذَا الۡقُرۡبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَ الۡمِسۡكِيۡنَ وَابۡنَ السَّبِيۡلِؕ ذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِ

translation.text: So give your close relatives their due, as well as the poor and the ˹needy˺ traveller. That is best for those who seek the pleasure of Allah, and it is they who will be successful.

commentary.text: Give relative their rights as well as the needy and the traveler, not because of your magnanimity but because this is their right due upon them from you. Allah SWT is the real owner of all your wealth and the extra wealth or savings has been given to you as a trial from your Lord to see whether you recognize and render the rights of others or not.

This does not mean that success can be attained just by rendering the rights of the relatives, the needy and the wayfarer rather it means that those who do not recognize or render these rights will not attain success. True success will be attained by those who render the rights sincerely and only for the sake of seeking Allah SWT’s goodwill and pleasure.

arabic_lines: وَمَاۤ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّبًا لِّيَرۡبُوَا۟ فِىۡۤ اَمۡوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِۚ وَمَاۤ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰٓـئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُضۡعِفُوۡنَ

translation.text: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give, seeking with it Allah's good pleasure, that is multiplied manifold.

commentary.text: Do not consume riba under any circumstance.  Money/property etc. earned via riba has no blessing in it. Rely on Allah SWT alone for your provision or no one else.

The basic philosophy behind riba (interest) in Islam is that it is a way of making money with zero effort and a no risk guaranteed return, such as, a savings bond with a guaranteed 3 per cent interest rate etc. However, buying property or mutual funds etc., does not guarantee a return because prices fluctuate.
Give Zakat so as to purify your wealth.
Hadith: Before we were born each person’s provision has already been decreed but we have to decide whether it will come to us in a lawful (halal) manner or in an unlawful (haram) way.
Lesson: Do your homework and understand what is riba then ensure that riba is not part of your life. Also calculate exactly how much zakat is due on you and give it!
Lesson: Looking beyond the apparent

Giving zakat, may seem like a waste or loss of money to some, however in reality it is the only thing that remains as it will be waiting for you in the hereafter. Whereas, the money that is spent in this life is gone with really nothing to show for it. Thus, apparently you are losing but in actuality you are gaining but gaining much more than you ever can imagine.

Riba: Apparently you may be gaining a trivial amount of money but you are losing in this life and the next. Allah SWT says; ‘ I wage war with those who consume riba.’ The punishment for taking riba is not limited to the Hereafter as there will be punishment in this world too.

For some, this life is apparently the only one you get so live life to the fullest fearing no consequences. However, those who gain knowledge realize that this world is a temporary abode or a prelude for what is the real and eternal existence – in fact our stay on earth will seem like an hour long on the DOJ (Ayat 55 —see below)

(30:55) But those gifted with knowledge and faith will say ˹to them˺, “You did actually stay—as destined by Allah—until the Day of Resurrection. So here is the Day of Resurrection ˹which you denied˺! But you did not know ˹it was true˺.
So, look beyond the superficial and apparent and gain understanding. Most people only know the outward show of world's life and they are heedless about the life to come. (Ayat 7—see below)
(30:7) People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.

Allah SWT and the Day of Judgment are part of the unseen realities and believing in them will yield results over time therefore for those seeking immediate gratification in this world the fairy tale existence of an unseen reality with the idea of delayed gratification is not something they can come to terms with.

sections.title: 41-45 MISCHIEF IN THE LAND IS THE RESULT OF MAN'S OWN MISDEEDS, THAT'S HOW ALLAH SWT LET THEM TASTE THE FRUIT OF THEIR DEEDS

translation.text: Corruption has spread on land and sea as a result of what people’s hands have done, so that Allah may cause them to taste ˹the consequences of˺ some of their deeds and perhaps they might return ˹to the Right Path˺.

commentary.text: This Ayat is probably more relevant today than any other time with riba/interest leading to unadulterated greed, wars, crime, pollution all rampant. This is all that we as humans have done to ourselves.
(Surah Sajdah Ayat 21 has a similar theme.)

arabic_lines: فَاَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ الۡقَيِّمِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِىَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ يَوۡمَـئِذٍ يَّصَّدَّعُوۡنَ

translation.text: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted, the Day when people will split into groups.

commentary.text: The Command to follow the straight path before the Day of Resurrection. Here Allah SWT commands His servants to hasten to obedience towards Him and to hasten to do good deeds.

arabic_lines: لِيَجۡزِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ

translation.text: so that Allah SWT may, out of His Bounty, reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + Good deed = Success
Allah SWT does not love those who disbelieve (kafir).

sections.title: 46-53 ALLAH SWT SENT HIS RASOOLS FOR THE GUIDANCE OF PEOPLE, SOME BELIEVED WHILE OTHER REJECTED, ALLAH SWT SUBJECTED THE GUILTY TO HIS RETRIBUTION AND HELPED THE BELIEVERS AND O PROPHET YOU CANNOT MAKE THE DEAD TO HEAR YOU

translation.text: And on the Day the Hour will arrive, the wicked will swear that they did not stay ˹in this world˺ more than an hour. In this way they were always deluded ˹in the world˺.

commentary.text: Even if thousands of years might have elapsed since their death, they will feel that they had gone to sleep a few hours earlier and then a sudden calamity had roused them from sleep. They used to make similar wrong estimates in the world, where they used to assert that there was going to be no Resurrection, no life-after-death, and no accountability before God.

translation.text: In the Quran We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them, those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say: “You are given to falsehood.”

commentary.text: The Quran provides us with examples that we can relate with and every subject has been tackled in a myriad of ways and every subject has been repeated over and over again – all so that we understand.

arabic_lines: كَذَلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translation.text: This is how Allah seals the hearts of those unwilling to know ˹the truth˺.

commentary.text: Yet, despite all the evidences, signs/miracles provided by Allah SWT some still just do not want to listen or understand. For such Allah SWT places a seal in their hearts so no matter what is being conveyed to them they do not have the blessing or good fortune to receive it.
Ignorance is mentioned here so imperative to strive and learn the Book of Allah SWT. Knowledge is key –Actively work hard to learn and convey.
Signs / examples of resurrection and the thus the certainly of the Day of Judgment.
Observe the people of past nations; their strength and their ultimate end.
Observe how we (humans) are given strength (youth) and then we are weak and feeble (with old age).
Life: barren land becomes fertile with vegetation upon the coming of just one rain.

sections.title: 59-60 IT IS ALLAH SWT WHO HAS CREATED YOU AND SHALL BRING YOU TO JUSTICE ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT

arabic_lines: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ

translation.text: Therefore, (O Prophet), have patience. Surely Allah's promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.

commentary.text: Prophet (PBUH) being address here and therefore by default all believers. We are reminded to be patient and remain steadfast in our faith. Do not get dissuaded or intimated by others. Allah SWT promise is a certainty (the DoJ is a certainty) – success will be yours, in sha Allah.

Lesson: Life is temporary so do not get caught up in the minutia and trivialities of life. Do not be short sighted and look only at the apparent as there is much more to what meets the eye.  Always remember that we will be meeting our Lord (probably much sooner than we ever anticipated).

Q. What does one do with savings or surplus money? (30:38 and 39)

A. There are two approaches regarding this concept in Islam: Firstly, give away all savings in either charity (to someone or in the way of Allah SWT) or give a loan to someone for their betterment. This approach requires having fully faith in Allah SWT re: the future.
Secondly, you can invest your savings but only in a halal manner.

But the main point regarding money in Islam that is to totally trust in Allah SWT for provision. Therefore, invest in your future by giving wealth in His way that ensures guaranteed returns on the DoJ (many folds more than your original investment) VS those living for this world while accruing riba/interest. Such people are only interested in this world and therefore only investing in this world.
What are you doing with your savings? Are you gaining the benevolence of your Raab or His warth?

front_matter.label: Name
front_matter.text: This surah is called Luqman after the wise man whose admonitions to his son have been related in Ayats 12-19.

items.text: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا لُقۡمٰنَ الۡحِكۡمَةَ اَنِ اشۡكُرۡ لِلّٰهِ وَمَنۡ يَّشۡكُرۡ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ

(31:12) Indeed, We blessed Luqmân with wisdom, ˹saying˺, “Be grateful to Allah, for whoever is grateful, it is only for their own good. And whoever is ungrateful, then surely Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: This surah was revealed approximately the same time as surah Al-Ankabut therefore it is a Makki surah with 34 Ayats in 4 Rukus.

front_matter.label: Subject and Topics
front_matter.text: The learned and wise people of the past imparted the same message that Prophet Muhammad (upon whom be Allah's peace) taught. It is as if to say, ‘O people! In your own country there has lived a wise man, named Luqman, whose wisdom is well known among you, whose wise sayings are cited in your daily conversation. So, consider what creed and morals he used to teach.’

sections.title: 1-11 AL-QURAN IS THE BOOK OF WISDOM, A GUIDE AND A BLESSING FOR THE RIGHTEOUS

arabic_lines: الٓمّٓ ۚ

translation.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.

arabic_lines: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡحَكِيۡمِۙ

translation.text: These are the Ayats of the Wise Book,

arabic_lines: هُدًى وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّلۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَۙ

translation.text: a guidance and mercy for the doers of good,

commentary.text: Surah Al Baqarah's first six Ayat’s are almost the same as the first six Ayat’s of this surah.

Quran is a Book full of wisdom and guidance, however, the people who will benefit/profit from this mercy and guidance are those who seek guidance and for those who do ahsaan it is a source of mercy of them. FYI – There are three levels of faith: (i) Islam (ii) then Iman and finally (iii) Ahsaan.

arabic_lines: لَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

translation.text: Those who perform the Salah and give Zakah and they have faith in the Hereafter with certainty.

commentary.text: Three qualities of righteous and successful people are mentioned: (i) They establish salah (prayer), this then creates God consciousness and piety as a permanent inclination within them (ii) They pay Zakat, this then strengthens within them the spirit of sacrifice; subduing the love of this world and awakens a desire for the goodwill of Allah SWT (iii) And they believe in the Hereafter, this then instills the sense of responsibility, accountability and answerability.

These attributes or characteristics allows man to be fully conscious and present of the fact that he is not independent but the slave of a Master before Whom he is answerable for all his activities and actions in life.

arabic_lines: اُولٰٓـئِكَ عَلٰى هُدًى مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ وَاُولٰٓـئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ

translation.text: and these are on true guidance from their Lord and these are the successful ones.

commentary.text: (Both in this world and in the Hereafter).
ALLAH SWT DEFINES SUCCESS

Context: The disbelieves of Makkah assumed that Muhammad (PBUH) and those who accepted his message were wasting and ruining their lives. Therefore, Allah SWT responded; “these people are infact the successful ones." That is, they will not ruin themselves as you seem to think in your ignorance, rather they are the ones who will attain true success.

Guidance is a favor and gift from Allah SWT. Thus, those who fulfill the above-mentioned qualities of (i) Salah, (ii) Zakat and (iii) belief in the Hereafter are given good news of success (in this world and the next.)
Thus, the one who regards true success as confined to the world, in the sense of material prosperity, is fully missing the Quranic concept of success.

To understand the real concept of the true success one should study the following verses of the Quran along with the relevant E.Ns: (Surah Al- Baqarah: Ayats 2-5), (Surah Aal-Imran: Ayats 102, 130, 200), (Surah Al-Maidah: Ayats 35, 90), (Surah Al-Anaam: Ayat 21), (Surah Al-Aaraf; Ayats 7, 8,157), (Surah At-Taubah: Ayat 88), (Surah Yunus: Ayat 17), (Surah An-Nahl: Ayat 116), (Surah Al-Hajj: Ayat 77), (Surah Al-Muminun: Ayat 117), (Surah An-Nur: Ayat 51), (Surah Ar-Rum: Ayat 38).

translation.text: But there are some who employ theatrics, only to lead others away from Allah’s Way—without any knowledge—and to make a mockery of it. They will suffer a humiliating punishment.

commentary.text: Context: This Ayat was revealed because of a particular event relating to Nadir Ibn Harith. He was one of the top businessmen from among the Mushriks of Makkah who used to travel to different countries in connection with his business. On one occasion he brought back a collection of historical stories featuring Cyrus and other Persian Kings from Iran. Thus, armed, he said to the Quraysh of Makkah: "Muhammad tells you stories of the people of Ad, Thamud and others. I shall tell you better stories, those of Rustam, Isfandyar and other Kings of Persia. They started listening to his stories eagerly simply because they contained no lessons to learn and no work to do. It was nothing but some delicious stories. Because of these stories, many Mushriks who showed some interest in the Divine Word found an excuse to draw away from the Quran.

The businessman mentioned above also brought with him a singing bondswoman. It was through her that he devised a plan to stop people from listening to the Quran and converting to Islam. When he found anyone intending to go and listen to the Quran, he would have him hear his bondwoman. He used to say: 'Muhammad makes you listen to the Quran, then goes on to ask you to pray and fast which make life difficult for you. Come, you listen to this music and enjoy the fun.'

The language in this Ayat is general therefore applicable today (probably more so than ever.) There are entire industries dedicated to ensuring that peoples free time is thoroughly occupied, whether it be the sports industry, video games, movies etc., etc. These industries not only take people away from Allah SWT rather it creates a mindset of misguidance. We are living in a time of immediate instant gratification via media such as Netflix, videogames, etc., so not a moment of your time is free. Free time should be spent in the zikr of Allah SWT and reflecting upon Allah SWT creations.
FYI – In the previous Surah Allah SWT talked about surplus income and what to do with it (30:38 and 39) now we are directed with what to do with our surplus/disposal time.
And when the Ayat’s of Allah SWT are recited, they mock and make fun of Islam.

Lesson: Young people are most affected by this industry so just as Luqman caution and advise your children at a young age about the value and importance of the most fleeting commodity that is “time”. Don’t waste a precious moment of it.

translation.text: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they turn away in arrogance as if they did not hear them, as if there is deafness in their ears. So give them good news ˹O Prophet˺ of a painful punishment.

commentary.text: When the Ayat’s of the Quran are recited then those who are fond of useless talk and play, tend to turn away and do not want to hear. In fact, it annoys them to hear it as they gain no benefit and have no interest in it.
Lesson: Check yourself. How do you feel and react upon hearing the Quran? Always ask Allah SWT for guidance and increase in Iman.
QUALITIES OF A DISBELIEVER

Those preoccupied with (i) useless activities and idle talk (ii) who ridicule/mock or make fun of religion (iii) turn away in arrogance/pride from the Ayat’s of Allah SWT. For such awaits a painful torment.

translation.text: Surely those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Bliss,

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + good deeds = success
(31:9 and 10) Proofs of Tawhid are in Ayats, signs, miracles within the universe.

Sky is above is without any pillars or support. Mountains standing firm with swaying. The rain from the skies, all kinds of vegetation, all kinds of living creators. Reflect on these as they are all Ayat, signs and proofs of Allah SWT. After recognizing the majesty of Allah SWT never then associate partners with Allah SWT.

sections.title: 12-13 LUQMAN ADVISED HIS SON NOT TO COMMIT SHIRK

intro.text: In Arabia, Luqman was well-known as a wise and learned man (he was not a prophet). He gave his son this advice on his deathbed – this was his wasiyaat or will. These are universal truths or fundamentals of religion that a person with a pure heart will arrive on his/her own (but only after much reflection/contemplation).

arabic_lines: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا لُقۡمٰنَ الۡحِكۡمَةَ اَنِ اشۡكُرۡ لِلّٰهِ وَمَنۡ يَّشۡكُرۡ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ

translation.text: Indeed, We blessed Luqmân with wisdom, ˹saying˺, “Be grateful to Allah, for whoever is grateful, it is only for their own good. And whoever is ungrateful, then surely Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

commentary.text: After presenting a rational argument to refute shirk, the Arabs are being told that this rational point of view is not being presented before them for the first time, rather the wise and learned people of earlier generations also have been saying the same thing, including their own famous sage, Luqman.

The very first demand of the wisdom, and understanding, granted by Allah SWT was that man should adopt an attitude of gratefulness and obedience before his Lord and not of ingratitude and thanklessness. And this gratefulness should not have merely been lip-service but expressed and translated in thought and word and deed. One should have the conviction in the depths of his heart and mind that whatever he has gotten, has been given by God.

Thus, the concept of gratefulness is at the head of wisdom.  Gratitude and humility go hand in hand because when we are grateful, we are giving credit to someone else as opposed to when give credit to ourself which results in arrogance.

Note: The gratitude or ingratitude of someone does not add or detract anything to His Godhead, as every particle in the universe bears testimony to His Perfection and Beauty, His Creativity and Providence, and every creature is paying homage to His glory perpetually.

arabic_lines: وَاِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمٰنُ لِا بۡنِهٖ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهٗ يٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِاللّٰهِ ؕ اِنَّ الشِّرۡكَ لَـظُلۡمٌ عَظِيۡمٌ

translation.text: And ˹remember˺ when Luqmân said to his son, while advising him, “O my dear son! Never associate ˹anything˺ with Allah ˹in worship˺, for associating ˹others with Him˺ is truly the worst of all wrongs.”

commentary.text: Luqman's Advice to His Son

First advice/guidance from father to son is to worship Allah SWT exclusively (Tawhid). Thus, instilling Allah consciousness is the first lesson. Luqman teaches his son lovingly and he addresses him in a very loving manner.

Do not commit shirk as it is a grave injustice or zulm. (31:13  لَـظُلۡمٌ عَظِيۡمٌ --worst of all wrongs). There could be no greater injustice than shirk since man establishes equals with his Creator and Provider who have no share whatsoever in creating him, nor in providing for him, nor in bestowing the blessings on him, which he is enjoying in the world.

sections.title: 14-15 THE RIGHTS OF PARENTS & BELIEF IN THE HEREAFTER

translation.text: And We have commanded people to ˹honour˺ their parents. Their mothers bore them through hardship upon hardship, and their weaning takes two years. So be grateful to Me and your parents. To Me is the final return.

commentary.text: Now Allah SWT is speaking as it does not seem appropriate for Luqman to start mentioning his rights as a father/parent.

Allah SWT says, ‘Be good to your parents but especially your mother who bears the hardship of bearing a child then breastfeeding the baby for or within the two-year limit prescribed in Islam. Allah SWT mentions how the mother brings the child up, and how she gets tired, suffers, stresses from staying up with the child night and day.
Lesson: We cannot be a good servant of Allah SWT if we are bad to our parents.
Additionally, we are told that the maximum period for breastfeeding a child is two years.

translation.text: But if they pressure you to associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. Still keep their company in this world courteously, and follow the way of those who turn to Me ˹in devotion˺. Then to Me you will ˹all˺ return, and then I will inform you of what you used to do.

commentary.text: Luqman, tells his son not to commit shirk but what if parents tell children to do shirk, as mentioned above?  Context: This Ayat was revealed in the matter of Saad bin Abi Waqqas – a young man who embraced Islam. When his mother, Hamnah, daughter of Sufyan bin Umayyah (neice of Abu Sufyan), came to know that her son had become a Muslim, she said, “I will neither eat nor drink nor sit in shade unless you disown Muhammad. The rights of the mother are superior even according to Allah’s command. Therefore, if you disobey me, you will be disobeying Allah too.”

To this threat by his mother, Saad bin Abi Waqqas response was: `O my mother, by Allah, even if you had one hundred souls and they were to depart one by one, I would not give up this religion of mine for anything, so if you want to, eat, and if you want to, do not eat.' So she ate.
The above topic is also mentioned in Surah Ankabut (see Ayat below:)

(29:8) We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents, but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate), do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I shall let you know all that you have done.
The rights of parents, among the creation of Allah SWT, are to be held as supreme however if one's parent's force you to adopt shirk, then they should not be obeyed.
Note: Nowhere in the Quran does it say to obey your parents but says to deal with them in a respectful and good manner. Follow and obey only those who are following Allah SWT’s path.

sections.title: 16-19 ADVISE OF LUQMAN ABOUT MORAL BEHAVIOR AND INTERACTION

translation.text: ˹Luqmân added,˺ “O my dear son! ˹Even˺ if a deed were the weight of a mustard seed—be it ˹hidden˺ in a rock or in the heavens or the earth—Allah will bring it forth. Surely Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware.

commentary.text: Luqman's Advice to His Son

Second advice/guidance is that all actions have consequences. Allah SWT is aware of all that you do so at all times be Allah SWT conscious or aware of the fact that Allah SWT is watching, listening and seeing.

On the Day of Resurrection all deeds whether good or bad, big or small all will be placed in the scales of justice and everyone is rewarded or punished for his/her actions. Even an action that is equal to the size of a grain of mustard seed it is recorded and has consequences. So be present and be cognizant of your Raab at all times. Allah SWT knows and sees all. Thus, Allah consciousness is being ingrained. Not matter where you are or what you do Allah SWT is always with you so rejoice and beware!

arabic_lines: يٰبُنَىَّ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاۡمُرۡ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَانۡهَ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِ وَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰى مَاۤ اَصَابَكَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ الۡاُمُوۡرِ

translation.text: O my son! Perform the Salah, enjoin the good, and forbid the evil, and bear with patience whatever befalls you.  Surely this shows your determination in conducting the affairs.

commentary.text: Third advice/guidance is to establish prayers/zikr of Allah SWT because it shows your gratitude and develops takkwa (Allah consciousness.)
Fourth advice/guidance is to enjoin the good, and forbid the evil. Then have patience.

(i)Establish prayer or the zikr of Allah SWT (ii) always enjoin people to do good, and forbid what is evil. Luqman knew that whoever enjoins what is good and forbids what is evil, will inevitably encounter harm and annoyance from people, (iii) so he told his son to be patient. Thus, focus on yourself and on others as we cannot live in isolation.

arabic_lines: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ مَرَحًا ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٍ فَخُوۡرٍۚ

translation.text: Do not turn your nose up at people, nor walk about the place arrogantly, for God does not love arrogant or boastful people.

commentary.text: Fifth advice/guidance is Luqman warning his son against being boastful, arrogant, proud and stubborn.

Do not turn your face away from people when you speak to them or they speak to you, looking down on them in an arrogant fashion. Don’t make faces at people consequently facial expressions should be humble.
ALLAH SWT DOES NOT LOVE: The one who shows off and venerates himself, feeling that he is better than others.
Hadith: Those who humble themselves, Allah SWT exalts them. Whenever a person is subjected to injustice leave the mater to Allah SWT then Allah SWT will come to his/her aid.

translation.text: Be moderate in your pace. And lower your voice, for the ugliest of all voices is certainly the braying of donkeys.”

commentary.text: Sixth advice/guidance: Have a balanced walk means to walk in a moderate manner, neither too slow or lethargic nor excessively fast, rather, somewhere in between these two extremes. This advice is not specific to walk rather every aspect of life should have moderation in it.

Keep your voice in moderation as well. Mujahid and others said, "The ugliest of voices is the voice of the donkey, i.e., when a person raises his voice, the resulting noise is like the voice of a donkey in its loudness and stupidity.

The haughtiness and arrogance of a person whether it be due to wealth, authority, beauty, knowledge, power etc. usually manifests itself in a person's gait/walk, manner of speaking and facial expression, thus revealing their state of mind. Adopt moderation in all facets of life whether it be your emotions, wealth, voice, walk etc. Avoid any extremes. Facial and body expressions of a believer should be respectful, humble and balanced.
Acknowledging Allah SWT as our Creator and Sustainer automatically inculcates humility and gratitude in us as we realize our worth and significance in the universe.

sections.title: 20-24 MAIN REASON FOR MISGUIDANCE IS THE BLIND FOLLOWING OF ONES FOREFATHERS

translation.text: Have you not seen that Allah has subjected to your service all that is in the heavens and on the earth and has abundantly bestowed upon you all His bounties, both visible and invisible? Yet some persons dispute regarding Allah without having any knowledge or guidance or any illuminating Book.

commentary.text: Reminder of Blessings. The entire universe has been created to serve humanity. Everything is working seamlessly and with humility, for example, the sun never flares up and the moon follows orders. It is imperative that we too should be humble and be grateful for all the bounties bestowed upon us.
Yet, some continue to aggressively deny Allah SWT and they argue/fight with no proof or knowledge. (So now we know how to respond to them.)
Same topic in Surah Hajj:
(22:8)And among men is he who disputes about Allah, without knowledge or guidance, or a Book giving light (from Allah).

translation.text: When they are told: “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say: “We will rather follow that which we have found our forefathers following.” (Will they follow that) even though Satan might invite them to the chastisement of the Blazing Fire?

commentary.text: These people did not gain any knowledge rather are blindly following tradition/ forefathers. They are in fact following the path to hell.
Lesson: Learn about Islam because on the DoJ you will be standing in front of Allah SWT alone.

arabic_lines: وَمَنۡ يُّسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهٗۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِالۡعُرۡوَةِ الۡوُثۡقٰىؕ وَاِلَى اللّٰهِ عَاقِبَةُ الۡاُمُوۡرِ

translation.text: Whoever surrenders himself to Allah and lives righteously grasps the most firm handle. The ultimate decision of all matters rests with Allah.

commentary.text: Allah SWT tells us that whoever submits his face وَجۡهَهٗۤ to Him meaning they submit fully and whole heartedly to doing what Allah SWT has commanded and abstaining from what He has forbidden then this person has received a definitive and firm promise from Allah SWT to expect goodness -- in sha Allah.
Lesson: Do not follow anyone blindly instead acquire knowledge of your religion and then surrender fully; entrusting all your affairs to Allah SWT.
Life is not easy. Tests and trails will cross our path but if we (i) fully submit to Allah SWT (ii) we do Ahsaan (ultimate excellence) then Allah SWTs help is with us. This is a surety!

sections.title: 25-30 IF ALL THE TREES WERE PENS AND THE OCEANS AND INK, ALLAH'S WORDS COULD NOT BE PUT TO WRITING

translation.text: And if all the trees on the earth were pens and the sea, with seven seas behind it to add to its, yet the Words of Allah would not be exhausted. Verily, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

commentary.text: If all the trees on earth were made into pens and the sea was made into ink, and topped up with seven more like it, and they were used to write the Words of Allah SWT presenting His Might, Attributes and Majesty, the pens would break and the ink would run dry, even if more were brought.

This means that the Wisdom, Commands, the way Allah SW unleashes His favors towards us that even if we tried to document it would just not a possibility, for example, just think about our bodies and how we should be thanking Him every second of every day for every seamless breath and every heartbeat.

translation.text: The creation of you all and the resurrection of you all are only as a single person.

commentary.text: His creation and resurrection of all of mankind on the Day of Resurrection is, in relation to His power, like the creation and resurrection of a single soul; thus, so easy and simplistic.

sections.title: 31-34 O MANKIND, FEAR THAT DAY WHEN NO FATHER SHALL AVAIL HIS SON NOR A SON HIS FATHER LET NOT THE SHAITAN DECEIVE YOU CONCERNING THIS FACT

translation.text: O people, fear (the wrath) of your Lord, and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child, nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah's promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you, nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.

commentary.text: This surah begins with a father’s loving advice and now ends with Allah SWT cautioning us about a day where no father will come to the aid of his son and vice versa. So be prepared!
This Ayat is, in fact an answer to the disbelievers’ question as to when the Hour of Resurrection will occur.

The life of this world envelops some so completely that they only see/perceive the apparent and superficial -- thinking that there is no life after this therefore, we should live life with no fear of consequences. They tend to whole-heartedly pursue wealth and power as the only real criterion often ignoring moral and spiritual values and boundaries. These and other such misunderstandings have been called deceptions or delusions of the worldly life by Allah SWT.

Don’t let entertainment deceive you. Part of satan's deception is to allow people to think they have the luxury of time – "you are young now so have fun now as this time will never come back again," -- whereas one of the key questions Allah SWT asks us on the Day of Judgment is how did we spend our youth? Did you waste your youth – a time when one is most vital and energetic? or did you devote you time to your religion?

translation.text: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs, although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow, nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

commentary.text: Time is of the essence. Allah alone has the knowledge of when the DoJ will occur so we cannot say we have time. This last Ayat gives us a sense of urgency to be grateful and humble to Allah SWT because the very next moment may be of death.
Wisdom for us is to surrender/submit and be grateful to our Raab.

items.text: LUQMAN'S ADVICE TO HIS SON

(31: 13) And ˹remember˺ when Luqmân said to his son, while advising him, “O my dear son! Never associate ˹anything˺ with Allah ˹in worship˺, for associating ˹others with Him˺ is truly the worst of all wrongs.”
DO NOT COMMIT SHIRK!

(31: 16) ˹Luqmân added,˺ “O my dear son! ˹Even˺ if a deed were the weight of a mustard seed—be it ˹hidden˺ in a rock or in the heavens or the earth—Allah will bring it forth. Surely Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware.
EVERY ACTION HAS A CONSEQUENCE NO MATTER HOW BIG OR SMALL.  ALLAH SWT IS MOST AWARE.
(31: 17) O my son! Perform the Salah, enjoin the good, and forbid the evil, and bear with patience whatever befalls you.  Surely this shows your determination in conducting the affairs.
(I) ESTABLISH REGULAR PRAYER (II) ENJOIN GOOD/FORBID EVIL (III) HAVE PATIENCE
(31: 18) Do not turn your nose up at people, nor walk about the place arrogantly, for God does not love arrogant or boastful people.
BE MINDFUL OF YOUR FACIAL EXPRESSIONS AND YOUR WALK. DO NOT BE BOASTFUL, ARROGANT, PROUD OR STUBBORN.
(31: 19) Be moderate in your pace. And lower your voice, for the ugliest of all voices is certainly the braying of donkeys.”
ADOPT MODERATION IN ALL ASPECTS OF YOUR PERSONALITY AND IN LIFE INCLUDING THE WAY YOU WALK AND THE WAY YOU SPEAK. AVOID EXTREMISM.

Thus, our attitude, personality and every part of our body should testify to the fact that Allah SWT is front and center in our life. The way we talk, walk, our body language, facial expressions all should confirm that we humbly acknowledge God’s supremacy and are grateful for all our blessings.
STEPS TO INSTILL TAWHID AND IMAN IN CHILDREN

Below are some practical suggestions to ensure our children grow up with a full understanding of what it means to have Tawhid and Iman (definitions below) in their lives in a very real and holistic manner:
Before the birth of your child:
First and Foremost is Dua: A Parent’s Most Powerful Tool:

As parents make use of the power of dua. Make abundant dua for your children: for their protection, as well as for them to be an immense source of benefit and delight to you and the world. It is one of the best things you can do for them. In fact, begin praying even before becoming parents!
When you plan to or are expecting a baby then follow the footsteps of Hazrat Zakariya who called upon Allah SWT saying:
(3:38) “My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.”
After the birth of your child:
Recite the adhan in a newborns ear. When a child is born, the first sound he hears should be of the adhan. Children are born upon the fitra of Islam so ensure they continue life on this ftira.

Call your child to the worship of Allah SWT whether it is via prayers, Quran, studying the Sunnah etc. The idea being that from a very early age it is instilled in the child that success in this world and the Hereafter begins and ends with Allah SWT.  To Allah SWT we belong and to Him is our return.

Develop an Islamic sleep routine: Recite Surah Al-Mulk to your child before putting them to bed. Instead of fairy tales, tell your children stories from the Quran of prophets, angels, as well as the incidents from the Seerah and the companions of the Messenger.

Look and reflect upon the creation: Draw the attention of your child to the skies and the sun, moon, stars, flowers, vegetation etc. This will help your child appreciate the magnificence of our Lord and how everything has indeed been made for our comfort.

Consistent remembrance and mention of Allah SWT and His messengers:  Develop a deep love for Allah SWT and His messengers in your child. A very special and emotional bond should be formed between the child and Allah SWT with the key components of humility and gratitude towards Allah SWT.
Help your child memorize the following surahs: (including but not limited to)
The shahada
Surah Al-Fatiha
The Ayatul Kursi
Morning and evening duas
Various selected Surahs from the Quran
These will help the child make a habit of constantly remembering Allah SWT.

Encourage Good Deeds: Explain to your child that good deeds will be rewarded and are a fundamental part of Islam. Let your child give charity by using the donation box in the Masjid. Encourage your children to part of a toy drive etc.
Ask Allah SWT Alone, and call upon Him using His names:

(17: 110) Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call – to Him belong the best names.” And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.

Teach your child about the names of Allah SWT and their attributes i.e. what each name really means and how it applies in our lives. For instance, we can instill the notion of only ever asking Allah SWT for provision by calling Allah's name of Ar Razzaq (the one who provides rizq) .
Lead by example. Parents are the best role models for their children. Go the mosque often with your children. Let them see you read the Quran and say your prayers regularly.

The very first advice of Luqman to his son: Avoid shirk (do not associate anything with Allah SWT. The two fundamental attributes (i) Tawhid (oneness of Allah) and Iman (faith) are at the very core for one to being able to stay away from shirk effectively.

UNDERSTANDING TAWHID: Tawhid is to believe in the Oneness of Allah SWT: that He is the One and Only God.
UNDERSTANDING IMAN: Iman means faith, and it stems from a person’s strong belief in Allah.
It has six facets. “It (iman) is that you believe in Allah SWT and His angels and His Books and His Messengers and in the Last Day, and in fate (qadr), both in its good and in its evil aspects.”
[40 Hadith of Nawawi, Muslim
Why is Avoiding Shirk the First Lesson in Surah Luqman?
(51:56) And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me
Thus, the very purpose of our creation/existence has been defined by Allah SWT is to worship Allah SWT alone.

(4:48) Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allah has certainly fabricated a tremendous sin.
Associating anything with Allah SWT is called shirk and is the foremost of the major sins.
Luqman understood the seriousness of this matter which is why avoiding shirk is the first instruction he gave to his son.
