front_matter.label: Name
front_matter.text: The Surah has been named As-Sajdah after the theme of Sajdah (prostration) as expressed in Ayat 15.

items.text: اِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِهَا خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوۡا بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ
(32:15) The only ˹true˺ believers in Our revelation are those who—when it is recited to them—fall into prostration and glorify the praises of their Lord and are not too proud.

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text: From the style of the surah, it appears that it was sent down during the middle Makkah period, as one does not find in its background that severity of the persecution and tyranny which one finds in the surahs sent down in the later stages. There are 30 Ayats and 3 Rukus. This is one of Prophet Muhammad’s favorite surahs and he would recite it on Friday mornings in its entirety.

front_matter.label: Subject and Topics
front_matter.text:
The main theme of the surah is: (i) Tawhid (ii) the Hereafter and (iii) Prophethood. The disbelievers of Makkah were constantly questioning (amongst themselves) about these three issues.

A special reward awaits those who forsake the comfort of their beds to pray at night and those who give charity – that is those who suppress their nafs/desires for Allah SWT. Their reward is immense.

It is Allah SWT's supreme mercy that He does not seize man immediately for his errors. Allah SWT does not punish him finally and decisively in this world but warns him beforehand by afflicting him with small troubles and hardships and calamities and losses and strokes of misfortune so that he may wake up and take admonition.

We are encouraged to reflect upon Allah SWT’s creation; that is, look at the administration of the heavens and the earth, consider our own creation and structure. Does the system of the universe point towards Tawhid or to shirk?

sections.title: 1-11 AL-QURAN IS BEYOND ALL DOUBTS, REVEALED TO MUHAMMAD, SO THAT HE MAY WARN THOSE PEOPLE TO WHOM NO WARNER HAS COME BEFORE

arabic_lines: الٓمّٓ

translation.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.

arabic_lines: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ

translation.text: This Book, beyond all doubt, was revealed by the Lord of the Universe.

commentary.text: The Quran is the Book of Allah in which there is no doubt.
Listen: Is the Quran God's Word? by Dr Zakir Naik. A beautiful lecture.

translation.text: Or do they say: “He has fabricated it? Nay, it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you; perhaps they will be guided to the Right Way.

commentary.text: Allah SWT is the Creator and Controller of the Universe

The first objection of the polytheists of Makkah, which they raised concerning the Prophethood of the Prophet (peace be upon him), is being dealt with. The Quran is the Book of Allah in which there is no doubt.

translation.text: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two, in six days, and then He established Himself on the Throne. You have no guardian or intercessor other than He. Will you, then, not take heed?

commentary.text: The second objection the mushriks raised regarding the message of Tawhid, is being dealt with. They were severely critical of the Prophet because he rejected their gods and saints and openly invited the people to worship Allah SWT alone with no partners.
Note: Allah SWT created the heavens and the earth in 6 days. (The term days is relative and for us 1000 years = one day for Allah SWT.)

translation.text: Who gave everything its perfect form. He first created man from clay,
Then He made his descendants from an extract of a humble fluid,
Then He moulded him; He breathed from His Spirit into him; He gave you hearing, sight, and minds. How seldom you are grateful!

commentary.text: The Creation of Man in Stages

These Ayat’s of the Quran point to the creation of man. If creationism is not accepted, then one will have to accept the utterly absurd idea that life originated merely accidentally; whereas even the simplest form of life as found in the single cell organism is so full of complexities and subtleties that regarding it as the result of an accident would be a million times more unscientific an idea than what the evolutionists think of creationism.

And if once it is accepted that the first germ came into being by an act of direct creation, it would be no longer difficult to accept that the first member of every species of animal life was created by the Creator’s own act of creation, and then its race started through different forms of procreation. If accepted, this concept would explain away all those riddles and complexities which have remained unsolved in their theory of evolution in spite of all the scientific theorizing by the upholders of Darwinism.
Hadith: After 120 days after conception Allah SWT sends an angel to breath the ruh or soul into the fetus.
(For further explanation, see (E.N. 1 of Surah An-Nisa), (E.N. 10 and146 of Surah Al-Aaraf), and (E.N. 17 of Surah Al-Hijr).

translation.text: They say: “Shall we be created afresh after we have become lost in the earth?” Nay, the fact is that they deny that they will meet their Lord.

commentary.text: Refutation of Those Who think the Resurrection is unlikely to happen
After answering the disbelievers’ objections about prophethood and Tawhid, now their third objection about the Hereafter is being dealt with.

The fact that they disbelieve in the meeting with their Lord does not stem from them thinking this is a remote possibility that may never happen but in fact, what prevents them from believing is their desire to live freely and independently in this world, openly committing sins and excesses without any accountability.

sections.title: 12-14 ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT THE UNBELIEVERS SHALL BELIEVE BUT THAT BELIEF WILL BE OF NO BENEFIT TO THEM (IT WILL BE TOO LATE)

translation.text: So taste the chastisement on account of your forgetting the encounter of this Day. We, too, have forgotten you. Taste the eternal chastisement as a requital for your misdeeds.”

commentary.text: Allah says to the disbelievers; in the world you became so absorbed in pleasure-seeking that you totally forgot that you had to meet your Lord on this Day. So now I will forget you. Punishment always fits the crime. Forget = Forget.
Allah will not even speak to some on the Day of Judgment. May we be protected from such an ill fate.

sections.title: 15 BE OF THOSE WHO IMMEDIATELY FALL DOWN INTO PROSTRATION THUS THOSE WHO SUBMIT FULLY TO ALLAH

arabic_lines: اِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِهَا خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوۡا بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ

translation.text: The only ˹true˺ believers in Our revelation are those who—when it is recited to them—fall into prostration and glorify the praises of their Lord and are not too proud.

commentary.text: PERFORM SAJDAH TILAWAT
The State of the People of Faith and Their Reward from Allah SWT

Those who accept Allah SWT’s Ayat’s as true when they listen to them and obey in word and deed. In other words, they do not regard it as below their dignity to give up their false notions and believe in Allah’s revelations and adopt His service and obedience. Their conceit does not hinder them from accepting the truth and obeying their Lord.

At this time reflect within to assess if we are of the ones who submit immediately and with humility or do we have even an ounce of pride and ego within ourselves that prevents us from falling down into prostration.

sections.title: 16 THERE IS A SPECIAL REWARD FOR THOSE WHO FORSAKE THEIR BEDS AND INVOKE THEIR RABB WITH FEAR AND HOPE AND SPEND IN CHARITY

translation.text: Their sides forsake their beds, and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope, and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.

commentary.text: Believers pray the voluntary night prayer and forego sleep and resting on a comfortable bed. Their meeting with their Raab motivates them to move away from their beds. That is, they do not seek entertainment in music, movies, dancing, drinking and merry-making at the night in order to get relief from the day’s fatigue. Instead, when they are free from their day’s work and duties, they devote themselves to the reverence of their Lord, spend their nights in His remembrance, tremble out of fear of Him, and pin all their hopes on Him. “Who forsake their beds….” does not mean that they do not sleep at all at night, but that they spend a part of the night in Allah’s worship.

In the original, rizq means lawful provisions. Unlawful provisions have nowhere been called rizq by Allah. The Ayat therefore means: They spend from whatever little or much of pure provisions Allah SWT has given to them.

arabic_lines: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ مَّاۤ اُخۡفِىَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قُرَّةِ اَعۡيُنٍۚ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ

translation.text: No person knows what is kept hidden for them of delights of eyes, as a reward for what they used to do.

commentary.text: No one knows the vastness/enormity of what Allah SWT has concealed for them (his righteous servants) of everlasting joy in paradise. Because they (righteous servants) conceal their good deeds, (meaning they don’t flaunt their good deed instead perform them in private only for Allah's delight) then Allah conceals the reward for them, a fitting reward which will suit their deeds.
Allah SWT says: "I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and it has never crossed the mind of man.''

translation.text: Would a true believer be like him who was an evil-doer? Surely they are not equal.

commentary.text: The Believer and the Rebellious are not equal

Here a Momin (believer) and a Fasiq (evil-doer or sinner) have been used as two contrasting and polar opposite individuals. Momin is one who believes in Allah SWT as his Lord, as the One and only deity and adopts obedience to the laws of Allah SWT. Contrary to this, a Fasiq is one who adopts the attitude of fisq (disobedience, rebellion, towards Allah SWT and instead obedience to others including their own desires.)
Thus, the believer and the non-believer can neither have the same way of thinking and lifestyle in this world nor will they be treated alike by God in the Hereafter.

arabic_lines: اَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡمَاۡوٰى نُزُلًاۢ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ

translation.text: As for those who believe and act righteously, theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in, a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman + good deeds = success.

Heaven is fully ready and awaiting the arrival of its beloved guests. Every need, wish, desire will be granted. Luxury, comfort and peace that are beyond one's imagination will be in Heaven in sha Allah. And for eternity this is their abode.

translation.text: As for the evil-doers, their refuge shall be the Fire. Every time they want to escape from it they shall be driven back and shall be told: “Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to reject as a lie.”

commentary.text: As for the abode of the disbelievers, it will be burning Hell Fire. A torment that is beyond one's imagination. A place that disbelievers will be perpetually trying to get respite from – trying to escape from -- even if for a few moments. But there will be no respite, no escape. And for eternity this is their abode.
Two very different outcomes have been mentioned above.

translation.text: And verily, We will make them taste of the near lighter torment prior to the greater torment, in order that they may return.

commentary.text: “The greater torment” is the punishment of the Hereafter which will be imposed on the guilty ones in consequence of disbelief and disobedience. “Lighter torment” are those calamities which afflict man even in this world, e.g., diseases, deaths of dear ones, serious accidents, losses, failures, etc. and storms, earthquakes, floods, pandemics, wars and other disasters, in collective life, which affect thousands of the people simultaneously.

The reason given for sending these lighter calamities is that the people should take heed even before they are involved in the “greater torment” and give up the way of life which will lead them to suffer the greater torment ultimately. These calamities remind each individual and groups and nation that there is another Power above them who is controlling their destinies. If man learns a lesson from these and corrects his belief and conduct here in the world, he will not have to face the greater torment of God in the Hereafter.

sections.title: 23-30 AL-QURAN IS THE SIMILAR BOOK AS THE BOOK WHICH WAS GIVEN TO PROPHET MUSA

translation.text: Verily We bestowed the Book upon Moses. So entertain no doubt if (the Prophet Muhammad) received the same. We had made that Book a guidance for the Children of Israel,

commentary.text: The address is directed to the Prophet (PBUH) and also the people who doubted his prophethood and the revelation of the divine Book to him. From here the discourse turns to the same theme that was mentioned in the beginning of the Surah (Ayats 2-3). The disbelievers of Makkah were saying: “No book has come down to Muhammad (PBUH) from Allah SWT. He has himself forged it and then claims that it has been sent down by Allah.”
The first answer to this was given in the initial Ayat’s. This is the second answer.

Why is it impossible that a Book be sent down to you (Prophet) as this is not a new or novel event. Before this, Books have been sent down to several Prophets, the most well-known among these being the Book which was sent down to the Prophet Moses (peace be upon him). Therefore, there is nothing odd and strange in this, which may cause doubts in the minds of the people.

The Arabs especially are being told that just as the Torah was made a means of guidance for the children of Israel, the Quran has been sent down for their guidance and for the guidance of all Mankind.

translation.text: Did (these historical events) not make them realise that We destroyed many nations before them amidst whose dwellings they now move about? Surely there are many Signs in this. Are they unable to hear?

commentary.text: Learning from Lessons of the Past

Learn from the lessons of the past nations whose destiny became dependent upon the attitude it adopted with regard to the messenger sent to them? If they rejected its messenger, the nation could not escape its doom. The only people to escape were those who believed in the messenger. Those who disbelieved became an object of warning forever and ever.

Lesson: Learn from the mistakes of others and then don’t repeat the same mistake in your life. This is a message, a moral that the Quran has emphasized repeatedly. Observe, learn and then do not replication mistakes.

translation.text: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this ˹Day of final˺ Decision, if what you say is true?”
Tell them: “If the unbelievers were to believe on the Day of Judgement that will not avail them. For then they will be granted no respite.”
So turn aside from them and await, verily, they (too) are awaiting.

commentary.text: Allah SWT is addressing the Prophet (PBUH) and thus by default all of us. Do not waste precious energy on those who are firm in their denial. However, do not stop conveying the message of Islam. The Prophet (PBUH) is told to continue to convey what has been revealed and thus now it is our duty and responsibility to convey the message of Islam.

They (non-believers) are waiting for the Day of Judgment and we too are waiting for the Day of Judgment. The outcome for each type of person has been already been described in Ayat 19 and 20. So submit to Allah SWT and fulfill the responsibilities Allah SWT has placed upon each one of us. Heaven awaits, in sha Allah.

items.text: Sujūd/ سُجود, or sajdah, is the act of low bowing or prostration in complete submission to Allah SWT, towards the qiblah (direction of the Kaaba at Mecca). It is performed during all prayers.

Humbleness and complete submission/surrender are the clear themes of this surah. We can do this most effectively while in sajdah. When in the position of sajdah/prostration we are the closest we can be to Allah SWT. We are submitting ourselves fully. We are placing our face down in front of our Raab and acknowledging His power and greatness.

Satan was the one who refused to prostrate in front of Adam. Therefore, when a Muslim observes this obligatory deed it greatly pains satan. Sajdah is a great means of making Shaitan fragile and weak, so perform it often.
TAHAJJUD SALAH
When the whole world sleeps, the Mighty Lord descends to the lowest heaven in the last third of the night to see who is awake remembering Him so prostrate during this blessed time.

Prophet (pbuh) said: “The Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the night remains and says: ‘Who will call upon Me, that I may answer Him? Who will ask of Me, that I may give him? Who will seek My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?’” [Bukhari and Muslim]

The Day of Judgment also referred to as the Day of regret and the Day of I wishing. So submit now and perform many obligatory as well as voluntary sajdahs.
DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
(32:19) As for those who believe and act righteously, theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in, a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.
Iman + good deeds = success.
ALLAH SWT’s PROMISE
(32:16) Their sides forsake their beds, and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope, and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.
(31:17) No person knows what is kept hidden for them of delights of eyes, as a reward for what they used to do.
SAJDAH TILAWAT
Sajdah tilawat (prostration) is performed while reading or hearing the recitation of specific parts of the Holy Quran.
Prerequisites Of Sajdah Tilawat
Cleanliness of both body and clothes (wuzu is not required but preferable )
Facing the Qiblah (Kaaba)
Making a clear intention of performing the sajdah
Procedure Of Sajdah Tilawat
Face the Qiblah
Express intention to perform sajdah – " Nawaytu Sajdatut Tilaawati lillahi Ta’ala"
Go down into prostration position after saying “Allahu Akbar” and pronouncing ‘Subhaana Rabbiyal A’ala‘ three times
Rise up from Sajdah with “Allahu Akbar”
“When you have recited a verse requiring sajdah tilawat, you should go down for sajdah with Allahu-Akbar and rise from sajdah with Allahu-Akbar (Abu Dawood)
It is Mustahab (desirable) to start from a standing position, however, one can also perform Sajdah Tilawat whilst sitting.

front_matter.label: Name
front_matter.text: The surah derives its name Al-Ahzab from Ayat 20. Hazab means to form a party/tribe or rally for a serious cause. Here it refers to the grand alliance formed during Battle of Ahzab.

items.text: يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ الۡاَحۡزَابَ لَمۡ يَذۡهَبُوۡا ۚ وَاِنۡ يَّاۡتِ الۡاَحۡزَابُ يَوَدُّوۡا لَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ بَادُوۡنَ فِى الۡاَعۡرَابِ يَسۡـاَ لُوۡنَ عَنۡ اَنۡۢبَآئِكُمۡ ؕ وَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا فِيۡكُمۡ مَّا قٰتَلُوۡۤا اِلَّا قَلِيۡلً

(33:20) They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault, they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst, hardly would they fight.

front_matter.label: Period of Revelation
front_matter.text:
This is a Madani Surah revealed in the 5th year of Hijrah.  It has 73 Ayats in 9 Rukus.

This surah was revealed after the battle of Ahzab and is twinning with Surah Nur. A number of social and political commands are included in this surah including, the practice of child-adoption, marriage customs, battle of Ahzab, Bani Quraizah, and issues related to hijab of Muslim women.  It also talks about the hypocrites and their role/conduct in society.

Makki Surah's contain the message of belief in Tauhid and DoJ (Iman). Madani Surah's contain commands from Allah SWT in them. This is because Iman precedes actions. Reflect: Is your Iman solid enough to follow the orders/commands of Allah SWT? Does your Iman match your actions?

sections.title: 1-3 FEAR ALLAH AND DO NOT OBEY THE UNBELIEVERS AND HYPOCRITES

arabic_lines: يٰۤـاَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ اتَّقِ اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ وَالۡمُنٰفِقِيۡنَ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيۡمًا حَكِيۡمًا

translation.text: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
Follow what your Lord reveals to you: God is well aware of all your actions.

commentary.text: The Command to defy the Disbelievers and Hypocrites by following the Revelation of Allah and putting One's Trust in Him

A powerful beginning to this surah where the Prophet (PBUH) is being directly addressed.  In the very first sentence, Allah SWT removes all hesitation of the Prophet (PBUH), as if to say: “We know better what is wise, useful and beneficial for our religion and what is not. Therefore, you (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) fear Us and not the disbelievers and the hypocrites.
‘Taqwa,’ means to act in accordance with Allah SWT laws thus adopt certain things/commands and leave others.

Historical context: These Ayat’s were sent down at a time when Zaid -- the adopted son of the Prophet (PBUH) -- had already divorced Zainab. Allah SWT inspired the Prophet (PBUH) to strike at the root of the tradition and customs of ignorance regarding adopted relations, and that he should marry the divorced wife of Zaid.

Yet, the Prophet (PBUH) was hesitant fearing that this would provide a strong excuse to the disbelievers and the hypocrites; who were already burning with jealousy at his successive victories, to start a propaganda campaign against him.

This fear was not due to any apprehension for personal defamation, but for the reason that it would harm Islam; causing mistrust of Islam among the people who were inclined towards it and cause the weak-minded people among the Muslims to become involved in doubts and suspicions. Therefore, the Prophet (PBUH) thought it was unwise to take a step for the eradication of a custom of ignorance, which would harm the greater interests and objectives of Islam.
After the first ruku this topic is mentioned again in the fourth ruku.

arabic_lines: وَّتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى اللّٰهِ ؕ وَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ وَكِيۡلًا

translation.text: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.

commentary.text: Beautiful Ayat
Also see (33:49)

The Prophet (PBUH) is being instructed to carry out the duty being entrusted with full confidence in Allah SWT, and not care if the whole world turns hostile against him. Allah SWT is enough for us so entrust all our affairs to Him. Allah SWT is the best guardian, protector and helper
After This Intro Now Begins The Commands Mentioned Below.

sections.title: 4-5 BY WORDS OF MOUTH NEITHER YOUR WIVES BECOME YOUR MOTHERS NOR ADOPTED SONS BECOME YOUR REAL SONS

translation.text: Allah has never put two hearts within one person's body; nor has He made your wives, whom you compare to your mothers' backs (to divorce them), your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.

commentary.text: Allah SWT gives us tangible examples so as to understand concepts/ideas. Just like one man cannot have two hearts in his body similarly a man cannot have two mothers’ rather he only has one biological mother and biological children.

Thus, a man's wife does not become his mother if he says the words of “Zihar” to her. In old days when an Arab in the heat of a domestic quarrel, would say to his wife: “Your back for me is as the back of my mother,” thus divorcing his wife through" Zihar." it was thought that the woman was no longer lawful for him because he had compared her to his mother. About this Allah SWT says: “A wife does not become a man’s mother just because he has called her his mother or compared her to his mother. His mother is the woman who bore him. Only his calling his wife his mother cannot change the reality.
Similarly, calling an adopted child a son does not become the real son. Thus, adopted sons are not like your real biological sons.

translation.text: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers, then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances, but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.

commentary.text: An Adopted Child should be named after His Real Father – this is the command of Allah SWT

The first reform introduced in connection with the implementation of this command was that Zaid, the adopted son of the Prophet (PBUH), began to be called Zaid bin Harithah, after his real father, instead of Zaid bin Muhammad.

Moreover, after this revelation it was forbidden that a person gives his surname or last name to any other than his biological children. Thus, call them by their father’s name as that is the true statement. However, there is no harm if a person is called a son out of love. Likewise, there is no sin if someone calls another one a mother, or a daughter, or sister or brother, etc. out of affection.
If the biological father is not known then treat the child as a brother in faith and give the child a generic last name such as Abdulla or Fatima "Bibi" etc.
Allah SWT will forgive any mistakes made thus far.

Thus, two jihali practices or practices of ignorance were abolished (i) Pronouncing "Zihar" does not abolish a marital status (ii) the practice of making someone your son i.e giving them your last name and thus all the rights and responsibilities that come with it including inheritance was eradicated.

FYI – It should be noted that adoption is allowed in Islam and in fact it is encouraged to give shelter to someone who needs it but facts should be kept as facts. Similarly upon marriage a woman should keep her own (father's) name. It is a western concept to change a woman's name to that of her husband's because she then became the property of her husband. Also, how many times will a woman change her name if she marries more than once?
Note: One of the key objectives of the Sharia is to preserve lineage.

sections.title: 6-8 PROPHET'S WIVES ARE BELIEVERS' MOTHERS AND BLOOD RELATIONS HAVE GREATER CLAIMS THAN OTHERS IN THE BOOK OF ALLAH

translation.text: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other, and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah, blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah), except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.

commentary.text: Loyalty to the Prophet; and his wives are Mothers of the Believers
The relationship of the Prophet (PBUH) with the Muslims and of the Muslims with the Prophet (PBUH) is of a superior nature, over and above all human relationships.

The Prophet (PBUH) is more compassionate, affectionate and a greater well-wisher for all the Muslims than even their own parents or their own selves. Parents, wives and children can harm and treat each other in a selfish manner and at times even mislead them into committing errors and mistakes thus push them into Hell. However, the Prophet’s (PBUH) will do for us only that which results in and leads to our eternal well-being and salvation Then the right on all Muslims is that they show the Prophet (PBUH) greater regard than their own parents, their own children, even their own selves.

In this connection, the wives of the Prophet (PBUH) are the mothers of all Believers only in the sense that the Muslims are under an obligation to have reverence and respect for them, and no Muslim could marry them.
….According to the Book of Allah, blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah),

This is an abrogation of the rule that existed previously, whereby people could inherit from one another by virtue of the oath of brotherhood between them. Ibn Abbas and others said: "A Muhajir would inherit from an Ansari even though they were not related by blood, because of the brotherhood established between. Also adopted children do not get inheritance.
Although Allah SWT legislated something at a certain time, there is wisdom behind its abrogation. And Allah SWT knows best.
….except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish).
Although adopted children have no part of inheritance. Exception: You can gift 1/3 of your wealth to anyone you want (close friends etc.)
The concept of inheriting from one another was abolished, but there remains the duty to offer support and kindness, to uphold ties of brotherhood and to offer good advice.
This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.
This ruling that blood relations have precedence over all other relations is a ruling that Allah SWT has decreed and which is written in the First Book. This ruling cannot be altered or changed.
Lesson: Friends are friends and Family is family.

sections.title: 9-11 FAVORS OF ALLAH DURING THE BATTLE OF TRENCH

translation.text: Believers, call to mind Allah's favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and armies/hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.

commentary.text: Second and third ruku are regarding the Battle of the Trench (Al-Ahzab)
How the Believers were tested, and the Position of the Hypocrites during the Battle of Al-Khandaq (Ayat 9-27).
Historical Context of the Battle of the Trench

A grand alliance was formed between the Quraysh, Bani Ghatafan, and the Jews of Banu Nadir, with an army of 12,000 strong. While the Muslims were only 3,000 strong and that too with some hypocrites in the army as well.

When the Messenger of Allah SWT heard that the army had set out, he commanded the Muslims to dig a ditch (Khandaq) around Madina. This was on the advice of Salman Al-Farisi, may Allah be pleased with him. This was a time when the Muslims were starving from hunger and it was bitterly cold. Now they had to dig a trench and prepare for war. Hence Allah SWT was testing the Muslims through an exceedingly hard and fearful time.

The result was that the grand alliance failed because when the mushrikeen reached Madinah they became totally confused as to how to cross the trench and were forced to camp outside Madinah. But they were not prepared for a long stay (about a month) that began to cause internal conflict/friction. While the siege of Madinah lasted about a month, and although no battle took place, the true Muslims and the hypocrites were exposed. Then Allah SWT sent a windstorm and hosts/armies (angels) that destroyed the enemy and forced a retreat. Hence, the Muslims won the war and hypocrites were exposed clearly.
Then We sent against them a wind and armies/hosts that you did not see….

Implies the hidden powers that operate in the affairs of men under Allah’s command and of which men are totally unaware. Man regards the occurrence of events and incidents as resulting from apparent causes and does not take into account the hidden forces at work, whereas in most cases these very hidden forces play the decisive role. In this case Allah SWT sent a strong wind and armies of angels.

translation.text: ˹Remember˺ when they came at you from east and west, when your eyes grew wild ˹in horror˺ and your hearts jumped into your throats, and you entertained ˹conflicting˺ thoughts about Allah.

commentary.text: When the enemies came from all sides the Muslims were so fearful that their eyes rolled up and their hearts reached their throats. Depending on their level of faith people had different reactions and thoughts about Allah SWT.

Lesson: Things happen that are out of our control but our reactions are in our control. In stressful situations be careful of how you react and what you say because it is being recorded. A Believer is always hopeful/positive of the good that will come out of a bad/difficult situation while the kafir always asks why?

sections.title: 12-15 ATTITUDE OF THE HYPOCRITES DURING THE BATTLE OF TRENCH

translation.text: And ˹remember˺ when the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts said, “Allah and His Messenger have promised us nothing but delusion!”

commentary.text: The hypocrisy of some became apparent when they expressed the thoughts that were in their hearts because of the weakness of faith and difficulty of the situation. While others said, as Allah tells us.
Lesson: In difficult times never express anger against Allah SWT. A Believer is always patient and hopeful.

translation.text: And ˹remember˺ when a group of them said, “O people of Yathrib! There is no point in you staying ˹here˺, so retreat!” Another group of them asked the Prophet’s permission ˹to leave˺, saying, “Our homes are vulnerable,” while ˹in fact˺ they were not vulnerable. They only wished to flee.

commentary.text: The hypocrites among the Muslims started questioning Allah SWT's promise of help. They tried to distance or dissociate themselves from the Believers by saying “O people of Yathrib! Instead of "O people of Madinah" so as to distance themselves from Islam and the Prophet (PBUH). They wanted to turn back to when Madian was called Yasthrib.

Then others made an excuse to leave to go and protect their houses and families, whom they claimed were under threat. In fact, there was no such danger but just an attempt by the hypocrites to flee the battleground – a lame excuse indeed.

sections.title: 16-20 THOSE WHO DISCOURAGE OTHERS FROM PARTICIPATING IN FIGHT AGAINST THE UNBELIEVERS AND DON'T PARTICIPATE IN SUCH A WAR THEMSELVES HAVE NO FAITH AND ALL THEIR DEEDS WILL BE VOID

translation.text: Allah knows well those among you who discourage ˹others from fighting˺, saying ˹secretly˺ to their brothers, “Stay with us,” and who themselves hardly take part in fighting.

commentary.text: Some encouraged others to abandon the Prophet (PBUH) and not become involved in dangers and afflictions for the sake of the faith and truth. ‘Live a life of ease and comfort as we do,’ they said. In times of difficulty some will not do anything themselves but will also discourage others from doing anything.
Hadith: The Prophet (PBUH) said I fear for my ummah a hypocrite that knows how to talk.
Lesson: Beware of anyone who distracts or discourages you from doing what good you want to do!

arabic_lines: يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ الۡاَحۡزَابَ لَمۡ يَذۡهَبُوۡا ۚ وَاِنۡ يَّاۡتِ الۡاَحۡزَابُ يَوَدُّوۡا لَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ بَادُوۡنَ فِى الۡاَعۡرَابِ يَسۡـاَ لُوۡنَ عَنۡ اَنۡۢبَآئِكُمۡ ؕ وَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا فِيۡكُمۡ مَّا قٰتَلُوۡۤا اِلَّا قَلِيۡلً

translation.text: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault, they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst, hardly would they fight.

commentary.text: Another aspect of the hypocrite’s abhorrent attribute of cowardice and fear is mentioned. They thought that the Confederates have not yet fully withdrawn/retreated and that they were close by ready to return. Thus, they hoped that if the Confederates should come back, they would not be present in Madinah, rather that they would be in the desert, just asking about news regarding the battle from afar.
But even if they are among the fighters in the battlefield, they would not fight much due to their cowardice and lack of strong faith.

sections.title: 21-24 THE LIFE OF RASOOL ALLAH (MUHAMMAD) IS THE BEST MODEL FOR YOU

arabic_lines: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِىۡ رَسُوۡلِ اللّٰهِ اُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوا اللّٰهَ وَالۡيَوۡمَ الۡاٰخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا ؕ

translation.text: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah, for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.

commentary.text: The Command to follow the Messenger

Following the character of the hypocrites now is described the best character that is the character of the Prophet (PBUH). What is Uswa-e-Hussana اُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ? Usually we associate Uswa-e- Hussana with the most excellent example of the Prophet (PBUH) and in doing small sunnah things like miswak, growing a beard, wearing pants high up etc.  This is all fine and good but this is at the micro level.

At the macro level "Uswa-e-Hussana," of the Prophet (PBUH) means to fight against injustice with all your might. Prophet (PBUH) did this in the most exemplary manner for most of his life. Despite having a successful business after the age of 40 years, he dedicated every second of his life to the cause of spreading Islam and thus gaining the pleasure of his Raab. This is the macro level sunnah that each Muslim MUST incorporate in his/her life (at least to some extent).

Allah SWT says to those who were anxious, impatient and shaken by feelings of panic on the day of Al-Ahzab to take the Prophet (PBUH) as your leader and follow him.  Allah SWT commands people to take the Prophet (PBUH) as an example during the battle of Al-Ahzab, with regard to patience, guarding, striving and waiting for Allah SWT to provide the way out. During the Battle the Prophet was at the forefront, digging the trench while enduring the most extreme cold and hunger.
This example of Uswa-e-Hussana is for those who: (i) Look forward to meeting their Raab (ii) Believe in the DoJ (iii) Remember Allah SWT much.

translation.text: As for the true believers, when they saw the invading confederates, they cried out: “This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true.” This only increased their faith and submission.

commentary.text: After presenting the Prophet (PBUH) as a role model now, Allah SWT clearly contrasts the characteristics of the hypocrites and that of the sincere followers of the Messenger (PBUH). Although both were apparently alike in the affirmation of faith, but as soon as the time of trial approached it became clear who was loyal to Allah SWT and His Messenger (PBUH) and who were Muslims only in name.
One situation, yet, reactions are totally different.

Here, one should keep in mind Ayat 12 when the hypocrites and the people with diseased hearts found themselves surrounded by a huge force of ten to twelve thousand men from the front and by the Bani Quraizah from behind. At that time, they openly started saying: “The promises that Allah and His Messenger had made with us were nothing but a delusion.”
Conversely, when the true believers saw the enemy, they said this is exactly what we signed up for.

This trial/test only increased the Believers in their faith and submission. If they die they die as a shaheed and if they fight they are fighting in the cause of Allah SWT and in sha Allah will be rewarded. So it is a "win win" situation. This attitude develops a beautiful aura of peace and submission surrounding a true Momin.
Lesson: Remember any test or trial that takes you away from Allah SWT means that you have failed.
Note: It is important to note that "Faith" along with the increase or decrease of it can only be judged and reckoned by none but Allah SWT.
Similar Ayats in the Quran re: tests; see below:

“Do you think that you will enter Paradise without undergoing such trials as were experienced by the believers before you? They met with adversity and afflictions and were so shaken by trials that the Prophet of the time and his followers cried out: When will Allah’s help come?” “Yes, Allah’s help is near.” (Surah Al-Baqarah: Ayat 214).

“Do the people think that they will be left alone after they have once said, We have believed, and they will not be tested? The fact is that We have put to the test all those who have gone before them. Surely, Allah has to see who are the truthful and who the liars.” (Surah Al-Ankabut: Ayats 2-3).

translation.text: (All this happened) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness, and either punish the hypocrites or, if He so wills, accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning, Most Compassionate.

commentary.text: This was a way of sorting out the Believers from the Hypocrites. But this is only for Allah SWT to decide.
SUMMARY OF CHARACTERISTICS (as mentioned above):
Hypocrites: (Traits to AVOID) Duplicity
Quick to lose faith and begin the blame game
Disloyal and treacherous
Fearful of conflict or any adversity thus readily retreat and or fail.
Discourage others from doing good.
True Believers: (Traits to ADOPT) Straightforwardness
Never loose faith in their Raab.
Loyal and steadfastness – thus ready to fight/assist/help/support.
Always brave and hopeful – no matter what the situation.
Respect and follow the Sunnah of the Prophet (PBUH)

sections.title: 25-27 ALLAH HELPED THE MUSLIMS TO GAIN VICTORY OVER THE UNBELIEVERS AND THE JEWISH TRIBES IN MADINAH AND KHAYBER

arabic_lines: وَرَدَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِغَيۡظِهِمۡ لَمۡ يَنَالُوۡا خَيۡرًا ؕ وَكَفَى اللّٰهُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ الۡقِتَالَ ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيۡزًا ۚ

translation.text: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed, their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful, Most Mighty.

commentary.text: Also see (33:3)

Allah SWT sent a violent windstorm and armies of angels to help therefore the Muslims did not have to fight the enemy in order to expel them from their land. Allah SWT Alone sufficed them and helped His servant by granting them victory.

And Allah SWT sent home the grand enemy alliance with the same rage and frustration they came with because they did not get a chance to fight and kill the Believers. Thus, they did not achieve a impressive victory that they could flaunt.

translation.text: Allah made you inherit their land, their dwellings, and their goods, and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.

commentary.text: Battle of Ahzab was a turning point – after this there was good news with the doors of victory now opened. Allah SWT says there are many nations/lands that you have yet to conquer thus predicting future victories.
Background: The Campaign against Banu Qurayzah
When the Confederates came and camped outside Madinah, Banu Qurayzah broke the covenant that existed between them and the Messenger of Allah.

This disloyalty greatly distressed the Messenger of Allah and the Muslims. After victory of the Battle of Ahzab the Messenger of Allah returned to Madinah triumphant. While the Messenger of Allah was washing off the dust of battle in the house of Umm Salamah,( may Allah be pleased with her), Jibril.
He said, "Have you put down your weapons, O Messenger of Allah!''
He said, "Yes.''
Jibril said, "But the angels have not put down their weapons. I have just now come back from pursuing the people.''
Then he said: "Allah, may He be blessed and exalted, commands you to get up and go to Banu Qurayzah.''

The Prophet (PBUH) commanded the Muslims to not lay down their arms before dealing with the Bani Quraizah as well. Banu Qurayzah, had committed a breach of their treaty right at the most critical moment of the war, joining hands with the invaders and thus endangering the entire population of Madinah.

When the Islamic army arrived under the command of the Holy Prophet himself and laid siege the tribe of Banu Qurayzah surrendered within two or three weeks on the condition that they would accept whatever decision Hadrat Sad bin Muadh, the chief of the Aus, would give. They had accepted Hadrat Sad as their judge because in the pre-Islamic days the Aus and the Quraizah had been confederates and they hoped that in view of the past ties he would help them.
He decreed that all the male members of the Quraizah should be put to death, their women and children taken prisoners, and their properties distributed among the Muslims.

The sentence was carried out duly. When the Muslims entered their strongholds, they found that the treacherous people had collected 1,500 swords, 300 coats of mail, 2,000 spears and 1,500 shields in order to join the war. If Allah SWT's succor had not reached the Muslims, all this military equipment would have been used to attack Madinah from the rear right at the time when the polytheists were making preparations for a general assault on the Muslims after crossing the Trench. After this disclosure there remained no doubt that the decision of Hadrat Sad concerning those people was absolutely correct.

sections.title: 28-30 ADMONITION TO THE WIVES OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD (PBUH)

translation.text: O Prophet, tell your wives: “If you seek the world and its embellishments, then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.
But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter, then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.

commentary.text: Now the commandments that began in the first ruku have been resumed here.
Giving the Wives of the Prophet the Choice

Context: The Ayat’s from here to Ayat 35 were revealed in the period contiguous to the battle of the Trench and the raid on Bani Quraizah.  According to a tradition related in Muslim, “One day when Abu Bakr and Umar (may Allah be pleased with them) visited the Prophet (PBUH), they saw that his wives were sitting around him and he was quiet. Addressing Umar, the Prophet (PBUH) said: They are sitting around me as you see: they are asking for money for household expenditure.”

At this both the companions rebuked their daughters and said, “Why do you embarrass the Prophet (PBUH) and demand from him that which he does not have.” This event shows how economically hard pressed the Prophet (PBUH) was at that time, and how distressed and embarrassed he was feeling at his wives’ demand for domestic expenditure during the period when a bitter conflict was going on between Islam and paganism.
Then Allah SWT revealed these Ayat’s. These are Ayat’s of choice, that is, do you choose the Home of the Hereafter or the Home of this world?

The Prophet (PBUH) was commanded by Allah SWT to offer an option to his wives – "takhyir". In Islamic law "takhyir" is the right to obtain divorce. The husband himself gives the wife the choice to stay in wedlock with him or be separated. The Prophet (PBUH), as is clear from the words in Ayat 28, said, “I will make a provision for you and send you off (by divorce), a graceful sending.” (That is if the wives choose to leave…)
Needless to say, all the wives of the Prophet (PBUH) choose to stay with him.
Note: The Prophet could have been very wealthy as he was successful in business but he said that wealth consumes a person and you leave it (wealth) behind (in this world).

translation.text: Wives of the Prophet, if any of you commit flagrant indecency, her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.

commentary.text: The Wives of the Prophet are not like Other Women
Allah SWT addresses the wives here directly. If any of you commit a sin then the punishment is double.

This does not mean that there was, God forbid, any chance of the Prophet’s (PBUH) wives committing an indecency, but this was meant to make them realize that they were the mothers of all Muslims; therefore, their responsibilities were accordingly very high, and so their moral conduct should be the purest.
Additionally, be under no delusion that you’re being the Prophet’s (PBUH) wives will protect you from Allah SWT'S punishment.
The Prophet (PBUH) is the best example for all of us but for females the best example are the wives of the Prophet (PBUH).
